screeningRules.summary: Normal FWS gate: continuous local stoppage ≥24 hours, or shorter action with material production/delivery loss. Verify each named site; never infer group-wide shutdown. P-Mat: latest 12 months; A-Mat Orders: 2024–2026 primary (latest 12 months fallback); A-Mat Sourcing is supporting. Broad strikes/logistics use preliminary internal information with affected suppliers/routes unresolved. Older than 3 days normally Noreply unless materially updated or continuing impact. Retain cancelled, postponed, recovery and excluded candidates. Every new scan must check Global Incident Tracker and Dragons Eye; this saved-list reconciliation does not claim a new full feed review.
screeningRules.logistics: Do not turn every isolated rail/road closure into route-check work. Retain strikes and major ports/borders/corridors with plausible procurement relevance. State VW route usage unknown. Passenger disruptions do not prove freight interruption.
screeningRules.age: Older than 3 days normally Noreply unless material update or continuing delivery impact. Dates should preserve event, publication and discovery distinctions.
